findings.title: Transfer with amount from instruction args (possible uncapped drain)
findings.fix: Cap amount (`require!(amount <= MAX)`), derive from on-chain state, or check source authority + balance.

findings.title: unwrap()/expect() on account/instruction data - panic DoS
findings.fix: Use `try_from`/`Deref` with error propagation instead of unwrap on external input.
